FA4_mCherry

```{r}

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data
#---------------------------------------------------------
des <- read.csv("FA_plate_layout.csv", header = TRUE)
data <- read.csv("FA_mCherry.csv", header = TRUE)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Convert Time ("H:MM:SS") into numeric hours
#---------------------------------------------------------
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    H = as.numeric(sub(":.*", "", Time)),
    M = as.numeric(sub("^[0-9]+:([0-9]+):.*", "\\1", Time)),
    S = as.numeric(sub(".*:([0-9]+)$", "\\1", Time)),
    Time_hours = H + M/60 + S/3600
  ) %>%
  select(-H, -M, -S)   # clean-up

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 2.1. Optional: choose a time window (example: 0–50 h)
#---------------------------------------------------------
data_subset <- data %>%
  filter(Time_hours <= 50)                           # adjust window as desired
# For 24–48 hours: filter(Time_hours >= 24 & Time_hours <= 48)


#---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Tidy data and join metadata
#---------------------------------------------------------
It <- data_subset %>%
  gather(key = "Well", value = "mChe", colnames(data)[!colnames(data) %in% c("Time","Time_hours")]) %>%
  left_join(des[, c("well", "bacteria", "fungi")],
            by = c("Well" = "well")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(bacteria))  # remove wells not in selected bacteria

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Calculate mean and SD per time point
#---------------------------------------------------------
Imean <- It %>%
  group_by(Time_hours, bacteria, fungi) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(mChe, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(mChe, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Reorganise and rename bacterial and fungal strains
#--------------------------------------------------------- 

Imean$bacteria <- factor(
  Imean$bacteria,
  levels = c(
    "no_bacteria", 
    "Escherichia_coli_Top10_wild-type",
    "Escherichia_coli_Top10_dTomato_clone_1",
    "Pseudomonas_brassicacearum_AF0029",
    "Pseudomonas_brassicacearum_AF0102",
    "Pseudomonas_brassicacearum_AF0191",
    "Pseudomonas_brassicacearum_AF0029_dTomato",
    "Pseudomonas_brassicacearum_AF0102_dTomato", 
    "Pseudomonas_brassicacearum_AF0191_dTomato" 
  ),
  labels = c(
    "Fungi only" , 
    "E. coli Top10 wt",
    "E. coli Top10 dTomato",
    "P. brassicacearum CC1-AF0029 wt",
    "P. brassicacearum CC1-AF0102 wt",
    "P. brassicacearum CC1-AF0191 wt",
    "P. brassicacearum CC1-AF0029 dTomato",
    "P. brassicacearum CC1-AF0102 dTomato",
    "P. brassicacearum CC1-AF0191 dTomato" 
  )
)

Imean$fungi <- factor(
  Imean$fungi,
  levels = c(
    "no_fungi",
    "3D7",
    "3D7_mCherry",
    "3D7_mCherry_AvrStb6_KO",
    "3D7_mCherry_AvrStb6_GFP"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "Bacteria only",
    "Z. tritici 3D7 wt",
    "3D7-mCherry", 
    "3D7-mCherry ∆AvrStb6",
    "3D7-mCherry + AvrStb6.1E4"
  )
)


#---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Plot using Time_hours (clean readable x-axis)
#---------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(Imean, aes(x = Time_hours, y = mean, group = fungi, color = fungi)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
    width = 0.2,
    size = 0.2
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ bacteria, labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 22)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Time (hours)",
    breaks = seq(0, max(Imean$Time_hours), by = 12)
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired", name = "fungi") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 2500)) +
  labs(y = "mCherry fluorescence") +
  theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, lineheight = 1.1),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black"),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 5, b = 5, l = 5),
    text = element_text(family = "Avenir Next Medium")
  )


#---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Save high-resolution figure
#---------------------------------------------------------
ggsave("FA_mCherry_48h_by_bacteria.png", width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 600)

```

FA4 - mCherry - subsetting some bacteria and time intervals

```{r}

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data
#---------------------------------------------------------
des <- read.csv("FA_plate_layout.csv", header = TRUE)
data <- read.csv("FA_mCherry.csv", header = TRUE)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Convert Time ("H:MM:SS") into numeric hours
#---------------------------------------------------------
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    H = as.numeric(sub(":.*", "", Time)),
    M = as.numeric(sub("^[0-9]+:([0-9]+):.*", "\\1", Time)),
    S = as.numeric(sub(".*:([0-9]+)$", "\\1", Time)),
    Time_hours = H + M/60 + S/3600
  ) %>%
  select(-H, -M, -S)   # clean-up

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Optional: choose a time window (example: 0–50 h)
#---------------------------------------------------------
data_subset <- data %>%
  filter(Time_hours <= 50)                           # adjust window as desired
# For 24–48 hours: filter(Time_hours >= 24 & Time_hours <= 48)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Select bacteria and fungi of interest
#---------------------------------------------------------
selected_bacteria <- c(
  "Pseudomonas_brassicacearum_AF0029_dTomato", "Escherichia_coli_Top10_wild-type","no_bacteria"
)

selected_fungi <- c(
  "3D7_mCherry", "3D7_mCherry_AvrStb6_KO","3D7_mCherry_AvrStb6_GFP"
)

des_subset <- des %>% 
  filter(bacteria %in% selected_bacteria) %>%
  filter(fungi %in% selected_fungi)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Tidy data and join metadata
#---------------------------------------------------------
It <- data_subset %>%
  gather(key = "Well", value = "mChe", colnames(data_subset)[!colnames(data_subset) %in% c("Time","Time_hours")]) %>%
  left_join(des_subset[, c("well", "bacteria", "fungi")],
            by = c("Well" = "well")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(bacteria))  # remove wells not in selected bacteria

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Calculate mean and SD per time point
#---------------------------------------------------------
Imean <- It %>%
  group_by(Time_hours, bacteria, fungi) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(mChe, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(mChe, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Reorganise and rename bacterial and fungal strains
#--------------------------------------------------------- 

Imean$bacteria <- factor(
  Imean$bacteria,
  levels = c(
    "no_bacteria",
    "Escherichia_coli_Top10_wild-type",
    "Pseudomonas_brassicacearum_AF0029_dTomato"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "water control",
    "Escherichia coli",
    "Pseudomonas brassicacearum"
  )
)
Imean$fungi <- factor(
  Imean$fungi,
  levels = c(
    "3D7_mCherry",
    "3D7_mCherry_AvrStb6_KO",
    "3D7_mCherry_AvrStb6_GFP"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "3D7 mCherry",
    "3D7 mCherry ∆AvrStb6",
    "3D7 mCherry + AvrStb6.1E4"
  )
)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Plot using Time_hours (clean readable x-axis)
#---------------------------------------------------------
ggplot(Imean, aes(x = Time_hours, y = mean, group = bacteria, color = bacteria)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - sd, ymax = mean + sd),
                width = 0.2, size = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ fungi) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    name = "Time (hours)",
    breaks = seq(0, max(Imean$Time_hours), by = 12)  # adjust tick density
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired", name = "Treatment") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 4000)) +
  labs(y = "mCherry fluorescence") +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA)
  )

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save high-resolution figure
#---------------------------------------------------------
ggsave("FA_Figure_5B_mCherry_48h.png", width = 12, height = 4, dpi = 600)



```

```{r}
#---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data
#---------------------------------------------------------
des <- read.csv("FA_plate_layout.csv", header = TRUE)
data <- read.csv("FA_mCherry.csv", header = TRUE)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Convert Time ("H:MM:SS") into numeric hours
#---------------------------------------------------------
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    H = as.numeric(sub(":.*", "", Time)),
    M = as.numeric(sub("^[0-9]+:([0-9]+):.*", "\\1", Time)),

  ) %>%

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Optional: choose a time window (example: 0–50 h)

  filter(Time_hours <= 50)                           # adjust window as desired
# For 24–48 hours: filter(Time_hours >= 24 & Time_hours <= 48)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Select bacteria and fungi of interest
#---------------------------------------------------------
selected_bacteria <- c(
  "Pseudomonas_brassicacearum_dTomato"
)

selected_fungi <- c(
  "3D7_mCherry", "3D7_mCherry_AvrStb6_KO","3D7_mCherry_AvrStb6_GFP"
)

  filter(bacteria %in% selected_bacteria) %>%
  filter(fungi %in% selected_fungi)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Tidy data and join metadata
#---------------------------------------------------------
It <- data_subset %>%
  gather(key = "Well", value = "mChe", colnames(data_subset)[!colnames(data_subset) %in% c("Time","Time_hours")]) %>%
  left_join(des_subset[, c("well", "bacteria", "fungi")],
            by = c("Well" = "well")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(bacteria))  # remove wells not in selected bacteria

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Calculate mean and SD per time point

Imean <- It %>%
  group_by(Time_hours, bacteria, fungi) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(mChe, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(mChe, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#---------------------------------------------------------

Imean$bacteria <- factor(
  Imean$bacteria,
  levels = c(
    "Pseudomonas_brassicacearum_dTomato"
  ),
  labels = c(

  )
)

Imean$fungi <- factor(
  Imean$fungi,
  levels = c(
    "3D7_mCherry",
    "3D7_mCherry_AvrStb6_KO",
    "3D7_mCherry_AvrStb6_GFP"
  ),

  "Pseu.-dTomato + Zt 3D7-mCherry", 
  "Pseu.-dTomato + Zt 3D7-mCherry ∆AvrStb6",
  "Pseu.-dTomato + Zt 3D7-mCherry + AvrStb6.1E4"
  )
)


```


```{r}

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Statistical analysis - Area under the curve with DescTools
#--------------------------------------------------------- 

auc_data <- It %>%
  group_by(Well, fungi) %>%
  summarise(
    AUC = AUC(
      x = Time_hours,
      y = mChe,
      method = "trapezoid"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#---------------------------------------------------------
auc_anova <- aov(AUC ~ fungi, data = auc_data)
anova_summary <- as.data.frame(summary(auc_anova)[[1]])

auc_tukey <- TukeyHSD(auc_anova)
tukey_results <- as.data.frame(auc_tukey$fungi)
#---------------------------------------------------------
ggplot(auc_data, aes(x = fungi, y = AUC, fill = fungi)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = ifelse(
      normalise_auc,
      "Normalised area under fluorescence curve",
      "Area under fluorescence curve"
    )
  ) +
  ggpubr::theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
  )
#---------------------------------------------------------
ggsave("AUC_boxplot.png", width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 600)
#---------------------------------------------------------
#AUC- area under the curve value obtain per well
write.csv(auc_data,"AUC_values_per_well.csv",row.names = FALSE)

#ANOVA only tells you if there statistical differences overall within the treatments
write.csv(anova_summary,"AUC_ANOVA_summary.csv",row.names = TRUE)

#Tukey posthoc will tell you about statistical differences between one-on-one treatment comparisons
write.csv(tukey_results,"AUC_Tukey_posthoc.csv",row.names = TRUE)
```

PSEUDOMONAS - DTOMATO


SUBSETTING ONE TREATMENT PER FIGURE DTOMATO

FA4 - dTomato - subsetting some bacteria, fungi and setting time intervals

```{r}

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Load data
#---------------------------------------------------------
des <- read.csv("FA_Liz_plate_layout.csv", header = TRUE)
data <- read.csv("FA4_dTomato.csv", header = TRUE)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Convert Time ("H:MM:SS") into numeric hours
#---------------------------------------------------------
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    H = as.numeric(sub(":.*", "", Time)),
    M = as.numeric(sub("^[0-9]+:([0-9]+):.*", "\\1", Time)),
    S = as.numeric(sub(".*:([0-9]+)$", "\\1", Time)),
    Time_hours = H + M/60 + S/3600
  ) %>%
  select(-H, -M, -S)   # clean-up

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Optional: choose a time window (example: 0–50 h)
#---------------------------------------------------------
data_subset <- data %>%
  filter(Time_hours <= 50)                           # adjust window as desired
# For 24–48 hours: filter(Time_hours >= 24 & Time_hours <= 48)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Select bacteria and fungi of interest
#---------------------------------------------------------
selected_bacteria <- c(
  "Pseudomonas_brassicacearum_dTomato"
)

selected_fungi <- c(
  "3D7_mCherry", 
  "3D7_mCherry_AvrStb6_KO",
  "3D7_mCherry_AvrStb6_GFP"
)

des_subset <- des %>% 
  filter(bacteria %in% selected_bacteria) %>%
  filter(fungi %in% selected_fungi)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Tidy data and join metadata
#---------------------------------------------------------
It <- data_subset %>%
  gather(key = "Well", value = "dTom", colnames(data_subset)[!colnames(data_subset) %in% c("Time","Time_hours")]) %>%
  left_join(des_subset[, c("well", "bacteria", "fungi")],
            by = c("Well" = "well")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(bacteria))  # remove wells not in selected bacteria

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Calculate mean and SD per time point
#---------------------------------------------------------
Imean <- It %>%
  group_by(Time_hours, bacteria, fungi) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(dTom, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd   = sd(dTom, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Reorganise and rename bacterial and fungal strains
#--------------------------------------------------------- 

Imean$bacteria <- factor(
  Imean$bacteria,
  levels = c(
  "Pseudomonas_brassicacearum_dTomato"
  ),
  labels = c(
  "Pseudomonas brassicacearum - dTomato"
  )
)
Imean$fungi <- factor(
  Imean$fungi,
  levels = c(
  "3D7_mCherry", 
  "3D7_mCherry_AvrStb6_KO",
  "3D7_mCherry_AvrStb6_GFP"
  ),
  labels = c(
  "Pseudomonas-dTomato + 3D7-mCherry", 
  "Pseudomonas-dTomato + 3D7-mCherry ∆AvrStb6",
  "Pseudomonas-dTomato + 3D7-mCherry + AvrStb6.1E4"
  )
)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Statistical analysis - Area under the curve with DescTools
#--------------------------------------------------------- 

auc_data <- It %>%
  group_by(Well, fungi) %>%
  summarise(
    AUC = AUC(
      x = Time_hours,
      y = dTom,
      method = "trapezoid"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

#---------------------------------------------------------
auc_anova <- aov(AUC ~ fungi, data = auc_data)
anova_summary <- as.data.frame(summary(auc_anova)[[1]])

auc_tukey <- TukeyHSD(auc_anova)
tukey_results <- as.data.frame(auc_tukey$fungi)
#---------------------------------------------------------
ggplot(auc_data, aes(x = fungi, y = AUC, fill = fungi)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = ifelse(
      normalise_auc,
      "Normalised area under fluorescence curve",
      "Area under fluorescence curve"
    )
  ) +
  ggpubr::theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
  )
#---------------------------------------------------------
ggsave("AUC_boxplot.png", width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 600)
#---------------------------------------------------------
#AUC- area under the curve value obtain per well
write.csv(auc_data,"AUC_values_per_well.csv",row.names = FALSE)

#ANOVA only tells you if there statistical differences overall within the treatments
write.csv(anova_summary,"AUC_ANOVA_summary.csv",row.names = TRUE)

#Tukey posthoc will tell you about statistical differences between one-on-one treatment comparisons
write.csv(tukey_results,"AUC_Tukey_posthoc.csv",row.names = TRUE)
```

STATISTICAL ANALYSIS


```{r}

#---------------------------------------------------------
# Statistical analysis: Area under the curve with DescTools
#---------------------------------------------------------

library(DescTools)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Calculate AUC per replicate well
#---------------------------------------------------------

auc_data <- It %>% 
  group_by(Well, fungi) %>% 
  summarise( 
    AUC = AUC( 
      x = Time_hours, 
      y = mChe, 
      method = "trapezoid" 
      ) ) %>% ungroup()

head(auc_data) #Optional

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 4. ANOVA
#---------------------------------------------------------

auc_anova <- aov(AUC ~ fungi, data = auc_data)

anova_summary <- as.data.frame(summary(auc_anova)[[1]])

anova_summary #Optional: to have a glance at the ANOVA

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Tukey post hoc test
#---------------------------------------------------------

auc_tukey <- TukeyHSD(auc_anova)

tukey_results <- as.data.frame(auc_tukey$fungi)

tukey_results #Optional: to have a glance at the tukey Posthoc results

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Plot AUC values
#---------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(auc_data, aes(x = fungi, y = AUC, fill = fungi)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = ifelse(
      normalise_auc,
      "Normalised area under fluorescence curve",
      "Area under fluorescence curve"
    )
  ) +
  ggpubr::theme_pubr() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1)
  )

ggsave("AUC_boxplot.png", width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 600)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Optional: export of statistical results
#---------------------------------------------------------

#AUC- area under the curve value obtain per well
write.csv(auc_data,"AUC_values_per_well.csv",row.names = FALSE)

#ANOVA only tells you if there statistical differences overall within the treatments
write.csv(anova_summary,"AUC_ANOVA_summary.csv",row.names = TRUE)

#Tukey posthoc will tell you about statistical differences between one-on-one treatment comparisons
write.csv(tukey_results,"AUC_Tukey_posthoc.csv",row.names = TRUE)
```
